'''Keev Crater''' was a [[City/Legends|city]] [[Domed city/Legends|enclosed within a dome]] and located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nox (planet)|Nox]] during the height of the [[Je'daii Order]] in the [[Tython system/Legends|Tython system]].<ref name="Into the Void" />

Circa 26,500 BBY the planet Nox had become so polluted it became necessary for the cities to be enclosed within atmospheric domes. Keep Crater was able to expand its economy by focusing on the manufacturing of dome components. Additionally, they cornered the market on dome maintenance and inspection, charging the other cities a premium for installation and upkeep.<ref name="Into the Void" />
